Companion Animal Travel Desk procedures in this section take effect immediately for daily work handling traveler pets. Purpose: This section standardizes how the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways coordinates safe, calm, and verifiable travel support for companion animals from acceptance through handoff.

All staff must treat each pet as a living passenger, not as cargo. When travel intake is complete, the desk must document the itinerary details needed for carrier handling and lounge assignment, then immediately notify the relevant ground team for carrier movement between services. Do not delay communication; urgency is required because missed handoffs cause stress, displacement, and cascading errors across the chain of custody.

For lounge management, staff must verify that the correct pet lounge is prepared before any arrival handover. <<FACT F002>> Every handover must include a quick confirmation of carrier condition, secure closure, and that the pet’s identifiers match the companion records on file. If any discrepancy is observed, the desk must pause further movement, report the issue without escalation theatrics, and request corrective action from the operations supervisor.

For lounge opening coordination, staff must monitor readiness events so that pets are received promptly and consistently. <<FACT F019>> Staff must communicate any delay to the ground team early, using concise and actionable language, and must avoid informal promises that cannot be fulfilled. During waiting periods, staff must maintain calm instruction to any companion or traveler present and must keep routes and holding areas clear for safe carrier circulation.

Cleanliness and dignity are mandatory. Handlers must follow hygiene standards, minimize noise near carriers, and ensure that the route from check-in to lounge and onward to the next service remains direct and controlled. If Samuel Costa or Ethan Ali are among the travelers, staff must use respectful, consistent guidance and avoid technical jargon.

In every case, the desk must confirm completion of each step to prevent gaps, and must record outcomes accurately for the next team member. For urgent operational guidance, contact the senior coordinator in Companion Operations.
